reviews.why: Mas que phooka is an exclamatory title derived from What the Phooka. Mas is not joining two clauses after a preceding icon. The comma rule misreads the icon as preceding sentence text.
Bode expiatório is the actual scapegoat meaning of The Whipping Boy, confirmed by German Sündenbock. Generic cliché advice would replace the intended referent.
Nu Mou is the invariant people name; os agrees with the plural referents.
The white lily is a family emblem, not a botanical species name.
The title deliberately names the high-stakes game. A cliché preference does not justify changing its meaning.
Mas is a nominalized objection in the title's but/butt pun, not a conjunction introducing a clause.
Os Thorne refers to the Thorne family. The family name remains invariant.
Deus ovos machina is a deliberate egg-festival adaptation of deus ex machina, not ordinary Portuguese number agreement.
The nominal title contains noite modified by não tão feliz. It requires no finite verb.
The title refers to Lightning as a female knight, not to an equestrian sportswoman. Cavaleira preserves that role.
Quebra-nozes is the musical title allusion modifying suíte by apposition, not an adjective that must become feminine.
Glamour deliberately preserves the source cosmetic-magic allusion. The barbarism preference would erase the title's link.
Todas preserves the source emphasis on all the bases.
Deixam a desejar preserves the leaf and leave wordplay.
Quarta names the Fourth Unit. It is not a weekday.
Ainda estou dormindo preserves the source meaning of still being asleep.
The first pacientes is a noun. The second is an adjective.
Ás is the noun for an expert. It is not the contraction às.
The title adapts Breaking into Hives through the natural idiom mexer num vespeiro. The source itself uses a risky-action pun. A generic ban on clichés does not justify changing it.
Dragão is an appositional type qualifier in the approved cavaleiro dragão label. Cavaleiros carries the plural. This is not agreement between a plural noun and a descriptive adjective.
Formando is a gerund describing training or raising knights, not an adjective agreeing with cavaleiros. The source Raising the Dragoons and all references concern candidates in training.
Vir a calhar is a lexicalized idiom meaning come in handy. The source glove/hand pun requires this sense. It is not a verbose auxiliary construction that can simply lose a verb.
Vital deliberately echoes the vitality potion referred to in the crafting request. The four-language title and Leve category support the pun; generic cliché advice would remove that connection.
A todo vapor adapts Cooking with Gas and keeps a cooking image alongside progress. The idiom is deliberate title wordplay, not an error.
The informal intensifier matches Bloody Good Tart, This. A quest-title joke does not require the formal-register restriction assumed by this advisory.
Tão is a degree adverb modifying secreto in the noun phrase Ingrediente nem tão secreto. No finite verb is present to create a verb-agreement error.
A luz and a escuridão are postposed subjects of vai, not prepositional complements. Neither a takes crasis. The parallel structure preserves As Goes Light, So Goes Darkness.
Sul is part of the name Sul Uin. It is not the compass direction.
À altura is a manner expression, not a reference to past time.
Uma mão lava a outra preserves the intended exchange of favors.
Brincando com fogo preserves the source fire theme and intended idiom.
A todo vapor is idiomatic Portuguese and preserves the literal steam/train allusion in Full Steam Ahead. The simplification would erase the title.
Para que possamos viver is a grammatical purpose clause and preserves That We Might Live. An infinitive is optional style, not a correction.
Todos sem exceção deliberately renders the inclusive emphasis of Her Children, One and All. The repetition is meaningful in this title.
Está is the finite copula with the subject Tudo o que você sabe and predicate errado. Esta would make the sentence ungrammatical.
The ellipsis opens a speech segment or resumes a thought after a line break; it is not a full stop joining independent sentences. The source uses this deliberate pause without a following space.
Mãos atadas preserves the literal restraint and the figurative All tied up? joke. Replacing the idiom would lose the source pun.
The ellipsis opens a speech segment or resumes a thought after a line break; it is not a full stop joining independent sentences. The source uses this deliberate pause without a following space.
The repetition is deliberate spoken hesitation or comic self-correction and directly follows the primary English source, rather than accidental prose repetition.
Todos estes expresses the full complement of Gilgamesh's many arms. Removing todos would weaken the source's pointed emphasis.
The leading ellipsis marks a resumed or delayed utterance, as in the primary English source. Joining it directly to the resumed word is deliberate dialogue punctuation.

Reitera la búsqueda de una persona Boonewa con cajado y pregunta por su interés en los cristales. Las cuatro versiones describen una consulta, sin objeto que el jugador deba entregar.

El resumen explica la compra previa y el engaño, y la investigación del valor de los cristales. No es el nombre de una recompensa ni una instrucción de uso. FR/DE/JA resumen la misma transacción pasada, con distinta extensión.

El resumen comunica que nadie quiere comprar ese material y que Nopli quiere detener al vendedor. Las cuatro fuentes se refieren a la estafa y a la continuidad de la historia, sin operación de inventario.

Gigimolu supone que pretenden devolver la mercancía vendida y niega reembolsos. Es diálogo hipotético sobre su transacción con Nopli; no aparece una orden o selección de entrega al jugador en ninguna versión.
Reprocha que Nopli comprara todo el stock sin discernimiento. Las fuentes remiten a la compra pasada; EN especifica stock completo y se conserva. No nombra un ítem utilizable por el jugador.
Gigimolu confiesa que aprovechó la ingenuidad de Nopli para venderle cristales sin valor. Las cuatro versiones describen el fraude anterior, no una interacción con Item45046.
Nopli usa la falta de dinero después de la compra como argumento de negociación de las escovas. Las cuatro fuentes mantienen esa causalidad comercial; no ordenan entregar cristales ni equiparlos.

Nopli propone que Gigimolu importe más material en el futuro en lugar de devolver dinero. FR/DE/JA y EN asignan el suministro al mercader, sin objetivo de adquirir o entregar Item45046 para el jugador.
